claim_text: Apollo 11 launched on July 16, 1969 at 13:32 UTC.
Eagle landed in the Sea of Tranquility on July 20, 1969 at 20:17 UTC.
The crew returned to Earth on July 24, 1969.
The mission collected 21.5 kg of lunar material.
Luna 15 landed softly on July 21 while Armstrong and Aldrin were on the surface.
About 1 billion people watched the moonwalk live.
Michael Collins also walked on the Moon.
Armstrong's first step on the Moon happened on July 20, 1969 (UTC).
The NASA Apollo 11 Press Kit (p. 212) states the crew had four members.
